description: This file defines the SqliteExpenseRepository class, which provides methods to persist, query, and delete expense data stored in a local SQLite database within an Android application.

classes.name: SqliteExpenseRepository
classes.description: Repository class handling expense data persistence using SQLite database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Inserts an expense record into the database and returns the row ID.

methods.name: listRecent
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent expenses with amount, category, and optional note.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Deletes all expense records from the database, returning the count of deleted rows.
